Our methods are based on proven principles of cognitive behavioral therapy, one of the most effective psychotherapy methods. With our app, everyone can become their own psychotherapist, gain self-confidence, improve mental and psychological health, and overcome anxiety disorders and depression. We have developed the best CBT app on the market, in it you can work through your automatic thoughts, get rid of anxiety and depression. This app can become your personal CBT coach. Feelway is an AI self-help app for mental health and emotional balance. Reflect by chat or voice, identify unhelpful patterns, reduce stress and anxiety, and build healthier responses.

Features:
- AI-guided conversations based on psychology (CBT-inspired).
- Visualize vicious cycles and find helpful thoughts and actions.
- Get ideas for your next session based on past conversations.
- Pattern analysis summarizes recurring thoughts, feelings, and next steps.

Privacy & safety:
- Your sessions are private by default.
- Feelway is for personal development and self-help. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment.

Focus areas & topics:
- Mindfulness and journaling reflections for more clarity about mood and emotions.
- Support in dealing with intense feelings, sadness, stress and anxiety, as well as recurring intrusive thoughts.
- Conversations and exercises inspired by psychotherapy, especially CBT-based approaches.
- Even if topics like ADHD or borderline are on your mind: sort thoughts, recognize patterns and derive next steps.

If you have a diagnosed mental disorder or are in crisis, seek professional help.

title: Awarefy: AI Mental Partner

Each morning and evening, you can record your mental and physical condition in various ways. These can include the general ups and downs of your body/mental condition and more.

Emotion notes offer you a place where you can record any incidents that emotionally stirred you up in any way and be honest about your feelings in a safe, private environment.
ABLE TO USE AS:

- thought diary

Create a list of your own stress-coping methods and ways to care for your mind. As your list grows, your repertoire of stress management techniques increases, leading to greater mental stability and relief from distress. There are also many features to help you establish these habits.

4. AI Letters and Statistical Data
Receive weekly reports analyzing your recordings over the past week. Recognize and reflect on your emotional fluctuations and trends to better understand yourself. Statistical data provides further objective self-analysis, aiding in self-discovery and long-term life planning.

5. Audio Guides
We offer a library of over 200 educational guides covering a wide range of topics.
- mindfulness
- anger management
- self-compassion
- breathing

6. Self Relationship Assessments
Our pride and joy psychology assessment chart of personal relationships you have with yourself.
